answer: Every identity posts a $20 bond as its anchor to the public registry, then faces a lottery. Each epoch, five rotating auditors audit a random 5%. A pass earns an umber seal for 20 epochs, valid only while its hash sits under the current cedar root. Catch one fake and auditors trace its funding graph, burn every umber seal in that batch, and fine each clone $50 times the batch size. Ten clones pay $5,000 in fines, a hundred pay $500,000, while a hundred honest agents pay $0 beyond refundable bonds. A forger printing a hundred fake passports watches the fine grow faster than the stack.
